global_rules.primary_keys: Opaque UUIDs generated by the benchmark service; no examples of real identifiers supplied.
global_rules.foreign_keys: Restrict deletion of referenced immutable records; use audited tombstones and approved content erasure rather than cascading away run history.
global_rules.timestamps: UTC timestamptz for observations; contract-effective dates and script event times remain separate.
global_rules.immutability: Versioned question/oracle/evidence/protocol/scoring content is immutable once referenced; corrections append records and preserve exact run snapshots.
global_rules.transactions: Short transactions for revision publication, freeze validation, dispatch identity and score snapshot commits; network/model work occurs outside transactions.
global_rules.indexes: Use declared B-tree/unique indexes for ownership, identity, roster and result selection. No shared BM25/semantic index of evaluation questions or solutions.
global_rules.cross_row_constraints: Roster cardinality, role separation, version matching, complete-criteria checks and freeze readiness need transactional service validation plus deferred constraint triggers where approved; plain column CHECKs cannot enforce cross-table facts.
global_rules.ownership_and_privacy: Every table belongs to the independent service; any broader delegation is explicit and audited. Protected artifacts never enter application logs, retrieval, tuning, shared queues or implementation-readable backups.
global_rules.readiness: Current shared filesystem and unresolved assessments are not frozen or release eligible.
global_rules.cutover: A passing benchmark report is only a prerequisite for a separate production-cutover approval.
global_rules.default_semantics: Required text identifiers are nonblank and bounded by the approved service contract; enums accept only listed values. Optional literal null defaults mean unknown/not-yet-observed, not pass. A none default requires the caller to supply a value.
global_rules.array_references: Array-member references require explicit deferred validation and dependency-preserving retention; scalar PostgreSQL FOREIGN KEY constraints alone are insufficient. Implementers must not silently omit this enforcement.
global_rules.artifact_contracts: Artifact type, contract name and contract version must agree with every consuming foreign key. Immutable payloads reject unknown fields; required fields have no inferred defaults unless the named contract explicitly defines one.
global_rules.question_projection: Reference question snapshots and cohort attestations exclude answer-like metadata. Exposure discovered after comparison is recorded even when a field was named title or distinction.
global_rules.field_traceability: Every field inherits entity requirement_traceability; protocol constants trace directly to the approved user acceptance targets. No shared proposal example contains actual benchmark inputs or outputs.
global_rules.candidate_isolation: Isolation verification covers the candidate adviser deployment as well as the benchmark store. Candidate logs, message storage, request capture, backups, queues and telemetry must not disclose benchmark questions/responses to implementation accounts.
global_rules.isolation_invalidation: A deployment, credential, logging, network or administrator-grant change invalidates affected isolation evidence. No new attempt or freeze may proceed until verification is renewed; interrupted/invalidated results remain auditable.
global_rules.scoring_discussion: The original operational-family target creates an interpretation decision; no permanent automatic ineligibility or automatic inclusion is settled here. Human resolution is required before protocol approval or freeze. Current attempts and pass counts remain zero.

acceptance_protocol.advice: Exactly 200 evaluation cases, 20 original families with 10 each. A case passes only if all three fresh independent attempts pass the frozen explicitly human-approved scope criteria. Require at least 180 overall and at least 9 in every family. The operational-family interpretation is unresolved; no evidence-limited policy handling may be relabeled success.
acceptance_protocol.knowledge: Independently complete relevant-rule denominators for all 20 insurers. Require at least 90 percent overall and separately per insurer. Unknown/partial denominators are unmeasured.
acceptance_protocol.robustness: All 60 frozen robustness checks pass, reported separately from advice.
acceptance_protocol.critical: Unsupported critical claims, incorrect eligibility, material calculation errors and customer-data leaks block the affected candidate, regardless of aggregate pass rates.
acceptance_protocol.attempt_failures: Missing, cancelled, unscorable and technical-failure attempts remain visible; no retry-until-pass substitution or denominator removal.
acceptance_protocol.evidence_limited: A correct bounded explanation, clarification or insufficient-evidence assessment is not successful resolution of an unsupported substantive policy question. Operational-scope treatment is separately unresolved for human discussion and cannot be used to relabel missing evidence.
acceptance_protocol.cohort_changes: Revisions or replacements require new reviewed immutable versions and a new valid freeze; no within-campaign post-failure roster edits.
acceptance_protocol.engineering_and_performance: Require matching verified customer-journey, engineering/security/recovery, performance and migration/rollback artifacts before readiness for cutover discussion.
acceptance_protocol.performance: At five concurrent conversations, p95 stored retrieval/rule evaluation strictly below one second and validated answers without external lookups strictly below twenty seconds; report cold/warm samples, queues, timeouts and failures.
acceptance_protocol.operational_family_discussion: Unresolved human decision. Permanently excluding the operational family from the numerator would make >=9/10 in every family impossible. Proposed interpretation permits a complete independently verified originally authored operational customer journey, while never counting evidence-limited handling as successful substantive policy advice. Approval must preserve exactly 200 cases, 20 families, >=180 overall, >=9 in every family and all three attempts; until resolved, protocol approval/freeze are blocked.

discussion_decisions.problem: Permanent operational-family ineligibility makes the original at-least-nine-of-ten requirement in every family mathematically impossible.
discussion_decisions.proposed_interpretation: Judge each originally authored operational customer journey against its complete independent intended outcome while separately reporting substantive policy-decision success. Do not count clarification/insufficient evidence as successful unsupported policy advice.
discussion_decisions.fixed_constraints: 200 evaluation cases; original 20 families with 10 each; >=180 overall; >=9 per family; all three independent attempts; critical blockers unchanged.
